design_principles: One-button focus: The primary action must dominate the screen.
Mobile-first constraint: On desktop, the app runs in a centralized max-w-md container simulating a phone screen, with a dark/subtle outer background.
Brutalist clarity: Sharp edges (rounded-none or max rounded-sm), high contrast borders (2px solid black), no soft shadows.
Typography as UI: Massive, tightly tracked headings and highly legible body text.

sizes.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter leading-none
sizes.caption: text-xs sm:text-sm font-mono tracking-widest text-zinc-500 uppercase

layout.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-white shadow-2xl relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col border-x border-zinc-200

components.button: h-14 w-full bg-zinc-950 text-white font-bold uppercase tracking-widest rounded-none border-2 border-transparent hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center gap-2
components.button_secondary: h-14 w-full bg-white text-zinc-950 font-bold uppercase tracking-widest rounded-none border-2 border-zinc-950 hover:bg-zinc-100 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2
components.input: h-14 w-full bg-zinc-50 border-2 border-zinc-200 focus:border-zinc-950 rounded-none px-4 text-lg outline-none transition-colors
components.chat_bubble_self: bg-zinc-950 text-white p-4 rounded-2xl rounded-tr-none max-w-[80%]
components.chat_bubble_other: bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-950 p-4 rounded-2xl rounded-tl-none max-w-[80%]
components.radar_ping: absolute w-full h-full rounded-full border-2 border-yellow-400 animate-ping opacity-75

motion.page_transition: framer-motion slide-in from right (initial: { x: 100, opacity: 0 }, animate: { x: 0, opacity: 1 }, exit: { x: -100, opacity: 0 })
motion.radar_animation: framer-motion looping scale and opacity pulse for waiting screen

assets.fallback_strategy: Image generation failed due to API limits. Rely STRICTLY on Lucide icons, massive typography, and high-contrast color blocking for visual impact. DO NOT use placeholder images.

specific_screens.landing: Clean layout. Top: Logo ('AERO-SHARE' in Outfit black). Middle: Form stack (Location, Airport Select, Time). Bottom fixed: Massive primary CTA button.
specific_screens.payment: Stark contrast. Large '£1.99' text. Subtitle: 'Non-refundable match fee'. Trust badges via text/icons.
specific_screens.waiting_radar: Black background. Yellow radar ping animation in center. Mono-spaced countdown timer. Pulsing text: 'SEARCHING WITHIN 15KM...'.
specific_screens.chat: Standard mobile chat layout but with brutalist aesthetic. Sticky header with match details. Scrollable messages. Bottom fixed input.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and configure Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and lucide-react.
Implement the 'mobile-first constraint' by wrapping the main App component in a centered max-w-md container. The `body` background should be `bg-zinc-100`.
Ensure all interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='airport-select').

Use standard HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts to preserve the brutalist edge. Avoid using pre-built Shadcn Card components if they force rounded soft shadow looks. Override Shadcn Select and Input components with `rounded-none border-2 border-zinc-200` to match the style.
For the payment wall, mock a minimal Stripe integration screen with a realistic-looking checkout layout.
For the waitlist, implement a simple audio `AudioContext` beep or use an HTML5 `<audio>` element with a synthetic notification sound when a match is found.
Since image APIs failed, do NOT use placeholder images. Use `lucide-react` icons sized up massively (e.g., `w-32 h-32 text-zinc-200`) for any necessary abstract graphics or empty states.
Write code for .js files, as the project uses JavaScript, not TypeScript.
